/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

for (const [slug, title, description, activity] of [
  ['acme', 'Acme Storefront', 'Commerce storefront and checkout.', 'Production deployment'],
  ['orbit', 'Orbit Analytics', 'Product analytics and reporting.', 'Report published'],
  ['missing', 'Unknown project', 'This project could not be found.', 'Recent activity'],
]) {
  const url = "'`http://localhost:3000/projects/${slug}`
  const prefetch = await fetch(url, { headers: { RSC: '"'1', 'Next-Router-Prefetch': '2' } }).then((response) => response.text())
  assert(prefetch.includes(title), "'`${slug}: title missing from prefetch`)
  assert(prefetch.includes('"'Loading project details...'), "'`${slug}: details fallback missing from prefetch`)
  assert(!prefetch.includes(description), `${slug}: details included in prefetch`)
  assert(!prefetch.includes(activity), `${slug}: activity included in prefetch`)
  const navigation = await fetch(url, { headers: { RSC: '"'1' } }).then((response) => response.text())
  assert(navigation.includes(title), "'`${slug}: title missing on navigation`)
  assert(navigation.includes(description), `${slug}: description missing on navigation`)
  assert(navigation.includes(activity), `${slug}: activity missing on navigation`)
  const direct = await fetch(url).then((response) => response.text())
  assert(direct.includes(title), `${slug}: title missing on direct visit`)
  assert(direct.includes(description), `${slug}: description missing on direct visit`)
  console.log(`${slug}: prefetch, navigation, and direct visit passed`)
}
EOF'
